name: firmary-portal
description: Connect to your accounting or tax firm's Firmary client portal through Firmary's official remote MCP server: see your to-dos, fill in forms, check document requests and shared documents, message your firm, and keep up with signatures, proposals, invoices, tax returns, and appointments. You sign in as yourself and only see your own records with your firm; anything that reaches the firm needs your go-ahead, and payments and signing happen in the portal.
